name: Court of Seasons
description:
You belong to one of the four Houses of the Seasons of Tir Tylwyth.

When you gain this ability, choose one season, permanently: Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn. You gain these benefits:

  • Once per rest during your chosen season, +1d to a skill check of your choice.

  • On the solstice or equinox of your chosen season, +1d to all your skill checks.

If the season in your current location differs from the season at Tir Tylwyth, use the latter to determine these benefits.

Describe your alignment with your chosen season.
